- [RARC.3.3.2] **Intra-process direct.** The lower tier's
  `publish` action surfaces as an `ACTION_PUBLISH` event on the lower tier's
  stream callback; the integrator's stream-cb body asserts
  the matching fact into the upstream tier's engine
  via a direct assert. No serialisation cost; both
  tiers share a process. Appropriate when the
  upstream tier must consume the lower tier's emits
  inside the lower tier's own cycle (tight-latency
  case).
